questions.stem: 這學期，許多學生一直在老師會播放舒緩音樂的美術教室練書法（calligraphy）。
questions.answer: This semester, many students have been practicing calligraphy in the art room where the teacher plays relaxing music.
accepted_answers: This semester, a lot of students have been practicing calligraphy in the art room where their teacher plays soothing music.
This term, many students have been practicing calligraphy in an art room where the teacher plays soft music.

questions.stem: 對很少用筆寫字的人來說，書法（calligraphy）已經成為一種新的紓壓方式。
questions.answer: For those who rarely write by hand, calligraphy has become a new way to relieve stress.
accepted_answers: For people who seldom write with pens, calligraphy has become a new way of relieving stress.
For those who hardly ever write by hand, calligraphy has now become a new way to reduce stress.

patterns: 對於…的人而言（For those who）

1.explanation_zh: 「這學期一直在練」表示從學期初持續到現在、而且還在進行，用現在完成進行式 have been practicing。「老師會播放舒緩音樂的美術教室」是一個帶有主詞（老師）的修飾子句，英文把名詞 the art room 放前面，再用關係副詞 where 引導子句；子句本身完整（the teacher plays relaxing music），缺的是地點，所以用 where（＝in which），不用 which。書法題目附了英文 calligraphy。
evidence: 老師會播放舒緩音樂的美術教室
1.strategy_zh: 判斷關係詞時，先看子句缺什麼：缺主詞或受詞用 which、that，子句完整只缺地點就用 where。
hints: 切成四段：這學期，許多學生／一直在（練書法）／老師會播放舒緩音樂的／美術教室
標的詞彙：semester（學期，L3）、practice（練習，L1）、teacher（老師，L1）、relaxing（舒緩的，L3）、music（音樂，L1）、room（教室，L1）
句型框架：This semester, S + have been + V-ing … in the + N + where + S + V …

2.explanation_zh: 「對…的人來說」用 For those who + 動詞（或 For people who …），who 子句說明是哪些人：rarely write by hand。「已經成為」用現在完成式 has become（become 的過去分詞還是 become）。「紓壓方式」寫成 a way to relieve stress 或 a way of relieving stress；relieve 是動詞、relief 是名詞。書法題目附了英文 calligraphy。
evidence: 對很少用筆寫字的人來說
已經成為一種新的紓壓方式
2.strategy_zh: 中文「對…的人來說」先寫 For those who，再把「…」的動作放進 who 子句；those 是複數，子句動詞不加 s。
hints: 切成四段：對很少用筆寫字的人來說／（書法）已經成為／一種新的／紓壓方式
標的詞彙：rarely（很少，L2）、write（寫，L1）、hand（by hand 親手寫，L1）、become（成為，L1）、way（方式，L1）、relieve（紓解，L4）、stress（壓力，L2）
句型框架：For those who + V …, S + has become + a new way to + VR …

references: This semester, many students have been practicing calligraphy in the art room where the teacher plays relaxing music.
This semester, a lot of students have been practicing calligraphy in the art room where their teacher plays soothing music.
This term, many students have been practicing calligraphy in an art room where the teacher plays soft music.

the + 地點 + where + S + V

accepted: This semester, a lot of students

common_errors.explanation_zh: many 後面要接複數名詞 students。
「這學期一直在練」是從過去持續到現在而且還在進行，用現在完成進行式 have been + V-ing。
完成進行式是 have been + V-ing。

parts.zh: 老師會播放舒緩音樂的
accepted: where the teacher plays relaxing music
where their teacher plays soothing music
where the teacher plays soft music
in which the teacher plays relaxing music
where the teacher plays calming music
where the teacher often plays relaxing music

common_errors.wrong: which the teacher plays relaxing music
common_errors.right: where the teacher plays relaxing music
common_errors.explanation_zh: 子句 the teacher plays relaxing music 本身已經完整，缺的是地點，要用關係副詞 where（＝in which），不能用 which。

common_errors.wrong: where the teacher play relaxing music
common_errors.right: where the teacher plays relaxing music
common_errors.explanation_zh: 子句主詞 the teacher 是第三人稱單數，動詞加 s。

traps.zh: 老師會播放舒緩音樂的美術教室
traps.literal_error: This semester, many students have been practicing calligraphy in the teacher plays relaxing music art room.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文把整個子句放在「美術教室」前面當修飾；英文要先寫 the art room，再用 where 子句放在後面修飾。

traps.literal_error: This semester, many students are practicing calligraphy in the art room where the teacher plays relaxing music.
traps.explanation_zh: 「這學期一直在練」從過去延續到現在，用現在完成進行式 have been practicing；只用現在進行式就少了「一直」。

1.restructuring_zh: 「老師會播放舒緩音樂的美術教室」是放在名詞前面的修飾子句，英文要改成「名詞＋關係副詞子句」：the art room where the teacher plays relaxing music。

For people who seldom write with pens, calligraphy has become a new way of relieving stress.

patterns.label_zh: 對於…的人而言（For those who …）
patterns.frame: For those who + V …, S + V
patterns.zh_trigger: 對很少用筆寫字的人來說

parts.zh: 對很少用筆寫字的人來說
accepted: For those who rarely write by hand
For people who seldom write with pens
For those who hardly ever write by hand
For those who seldom write by hand
For people who rarely write by hand
For those who rarely write with a pen
For those who seldom use pens

common_errors.wrong: For rarely writing by hand people
common_errors.right: For those who rarely write by hand
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「…的人」的修飾語要放在後面：those 或 people + who + 動詞。

common_errors.wrong: For those who rarely writes by hand
common_errors.right: For those who rarely write by hand
common_errors.explanation_zh: those 是複數，who 子句的動詞不加 s。
「已經成為」是到現在為止的變化，用現在完成式 has become。
become 的過去分詞還是 become；became 是過去式。
「一種新的方式」直接寫 a new way，不必把「一種」翻成 a kind of。
relief 是名詞「緩解」，動詞是 relieve；不定詞 to 後面接動詞。
介系詞 of 後面要接動名詞 relieving；或改用 a way to relieve stress。

traps.literal_error: For rarely writing by hand people, calligraphy has become a new way to relieve stress.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「很少用筆寫字的人」修飾語在前；英文要寫成 those who rarely write by hand，修飾語放在後面。

traps.literal_error: For those who rarely write by hand, calligraphy has become a new way to relief stress.
traps.explanation_zh: 「紓（壓）」在 to 後面要用動詞 relieve；relief 是名詞。

2.restructuring_zh: 「對很少用筆寫字的人來說」要把「…的人」改成 those who + 動詞（For those who rarely write by hand），修飾語放到 who 子句裡。

1.translation: This semester, many students have been practicing calligraphy in the art classroom where the teacher plays soothing music.
1.explanation_zh: 「這學期一直在練」是持續到現在的動作，用現在完成進行式 have been practicing；「老師會播放舒緩音樂的美術教室」用關係副詞 where 修飾 classroom；舒緩用 soothing。

2.translation: For people who seldom write with a pen, calligraphy has become a new way to relieve stress.
2.explanation_zh: 「對……的人來說」用 For people who ...；「很少」用 seldom；「已經成為」用現在完成式 has become；「紓壓方式」用 a way to relieve stress。

issues_zh: （不影響判定）第 2 部分中文標籤只寫「一直在」，但 accepted 是 have been practicing calligraphy，實際也涵蓋「練書法」；受限於 zh 必須逐字在題目，無法連續標出，回饋時最好在說明裡點出「練書法」算在這一部分。第 3 部分可補 where the teacher plays soothing music。
（不影響判定）第 1 部分可補 For people who seldom write with a pen（本盲譯寫法；清單已有 with pens／with a pen 的其他組合）。

1.translation: This semester, many students have been practicing calligraphy in the art room, where the teacher plays soothing music.
1.explanation_zh: 「這學期……一直在……練」表示從學期初持續到現在的動作，用現在完成進行式 have been practicing；「老師會播放舒緩音樂的美術教室」用關係副詞 where 修飾 art room，老師習慣性播放音樂，用現在簡單式。

2.translation: For people who seldom write with a pen, calligraphy has become a new way to relieve stress.
2.explanation_zh: 「對……的人來說」用 For people who ...；「很少用筆寫字」譯成 seldom write with a pen；「已經成為」用現在完成式 has become；「紓壓方式」用 a way to relieve stress（不定詞修飾 way）。

issues_zh: 第 2 部分的中文標示只有『一直在』，但可接受寫法與標的詞彙 practice 都要求 have been practicing calligraphy；『練書法』的『練』沒有出現在任何一個部分的中文裡，學生看部分標示不知道動詞要在第 2 部分計分。建議把第 2 部分中文改成含『練書法』的寫法（例如『一直在……練書法』），或把 practice 移到有對應中文的部分。

problems: 第 1 題驗證者對4 部分切分有意見（warn）：第 2 部分的中文標示只有『一直在』，但可接受寫法與標的詞彙 practice 都要求 have been practicing calligraphy；『練書法』的『練』沒有出現在任何一個部分的中文裡，學生看部分標示不知道動詞要在第 2
